QUOTE: "`schema`, server older than index, or `code`: restart the MCP client. Rebuilding does nothing for these, and the message says so." and "| `data` | ... | Rebuild (`index(action='refresh')`) |" and "| `code` | ... | Client restart only."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer shows different clearing actions per axis (rebuild for data, restart for code), but it never says this is why a single flag would not have been enough.
